newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS REV REPO RATE DIPS TO 13.05 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS REV REPO RATE DIPS TO 13.05 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Wednesday its reverse repo rate at a seven-day securities tender eased to 13.05 percent from 13.26 percent.
The NBS added that it drained funds totalling 2.475 billion crowns through Wednesday's tender.
Three weeks ago, the average rate in a similar tender was 17.3 percent.
The maximum bid in the tender was 14.5 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 12.0 percent, it added.
The NBS said that all 2.475 billion crowns worth of bids were accepted.
